summary.text: Zach Hudson is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 49 in East Multnomah County who has served since January 11, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A longtime teacher, he chairs the House Committee on Higher Education and Workforce Development.

paragraphs.text: Zach Hudson earned a high school diploma from Ashland High School, bachelor's and master's degrees from the University of Winchester in England, and a master's degree in education from Portland State University.
His career experience includes working as a high school and community college teacher.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had taught in East Multnomah County schools, including Reynolds High School and Mount Hood Community College, for 18 years, and that he served on the Troutdale City Council before his election to the Legislature.
Hudson succeeded Chris Gorsek in the Oregon House.

On his legislative website, he says he also serves on the House Education Committee, the House Revenue Committee and the Joint Tax Expenditures Committee, and that he sponsored legislation to fund a replacement for Fire Station 74 and to slow hospital closures.
